lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Neck-to-riser fold of about 90.5 deg, between outer skins 1 (plate underside) and 4 (riser back face). In my perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the line sits on the convex, larger-radius outer arc, 0.00/-0.01/-0.02 mm from it. The inner skin is about 2.85 mm further in, which is consistent with t=3.0. The line runs parallel to the fold axis and spans 23.3 mm of the 25.2 mm fold-zone width, including the edge roundings (about 92%). Sections at -10% and 110% are empty, so it does not run past the part edge.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Riser-to-top-tab fold of about 90.2 deg, between outer skins 3 (riser face toward the plate) and 5 (tab top). In my sections at 25/50/75% the line is on the convex outer arc apex, -0.05/-0.01/0.00 mm from it, with the inner skin about 2.8-2.9 mm inward. The tab hole cuts into the 50% section but sits away from the apex and does not interrupt the fold. The line spans 23.7 mm of the 25.3 mm fold-zone width (about 94%). It is parallel to the fold and stays inside the part.
